summary: Backend-only audit-completion pass tested via /app/backend/tests/test_audit_pass.py (15/15 PASSED, 100%). Verified: (1) admin login + /system/status shows ai/email/voice CONFIGURED and telephony/whatsapp/payments NOT_CONFIGURED; (2) POST /api/missions writes an audit_logs entry with event_type='mission_created' scoped to organization_id and readable via GET /api/audit; (3) Razorpay POST /api/billing/orders {plan_id:'pro'} returns status='NOT_CONFIGURED', provider='razorpay', with required env list (no fake order); (4) POST /api/billing/verify with junk signature returns 400; (5) POST /api/webhooks/razorpay with empty body and no signature returns 200 status='NOT_CONFIGURED' (no activation); (6) POST /api/voice/calls with a bogus vendor_id returns 404, and GET /api/voice/calls?mission_id=... returns 200 list; (7) POST /api/whatsapp/send with bogus vendor returns 404; GET /api/whatsapp/status returns state='NOT_CONFIGURED'; GET /api/webhooks/whatsapp with wrong verify token returns 403; (8) Organization isolation: newly registered user gets a distinct organization_id, GET /api/missions/{admin_mid} returns 404 for that user, and GET /api/missions returns only their own org's missions; audit entries are also org-scoped; (9) Free plan 4th active mission returns HTTP 402; (10) No regression on GET /api/dashboard/stats, /api/dashboard/analytics, /api/vendors/memory (all 200). All test artifacts cleaned up (test missions deleted, test_iso_* user + org + membership purged).
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py razorpay_webhook: when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set but RAZORPAY_KEY_ID is absent, code enforces signature but still proceeds to process events — acceptable but consider requiring both to avoid partial-config surprises.

whatsapp.py incoming webhook: _valid_signature returns True when WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is unset. In production this could allow unsigned inbound webhooks once WA credentials are set without app-secret. Recommend making app_secret mandatory whenever WA is live.

telephony.py: when NOT_CONFIGURED it still inserts a call row into db.calls, but does not call audit.log_event for that stub row. For a truly unified audit trail, log 'call_stub_recorded' in this branch too.
server.py continues to grow (now ~590 lines). Splitting missions/negotiation/offers into a dedicated module remains a good next refactor (already flagged in iteration_3).
